require 'fileutils'
require 'tempfile'
require 'digest'

module ImagePipeline
  class Config
    ALLOWED_FORMATS = %w[png jpg webp tiff].freeze
    MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024

    attr_reader :work_dir, :output_dir, :concurrency, :signal_mode

    def initialize
      @work_dir = ENV.fetch('PIPELINE_WORK_DIR', '/tmp/pipeline')
      @output_dir = ENV.fetch('PIPELINE_OUTPUT_DIR', '/var/output')
      @concurrency = ENV.fetch('PIPELINE_CONCURRENCY', '4').to_i
      @signal_mode = ENV.fetch('PIPELINE_SIGNAL_MODE', 'deferred')
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@work_dir)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@output_dir)
    end

    def immediate_signals?
      @signal_mode == 'immediate'
    end
  end

  class ProcessingState
    attr_accessor :current_file, :temp_files, :completed, :lock_held

    def initialize
      @current_file = nil
      @temp_files = []
      @completed = []
      @lock_held = false
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def synchronize(&block)
      @mutex.synchronize(&block)
    end

    def cleanup_temps
      @temp_files.each { |f| File.delete(f) if File.exist?(f) }
      @temp_files.clear
    end
  end

  class Pipeline
    def initialize(config = Config.new)
      @config = config
      @state = ProcessingState.new
      @shutdown_requested = false
      setup_signal_handlers
    end

    def setup_signal_handlers
      setup_deferred_handlers
    end

    def setup_deferred_handlers
      @pending_signals = Queue.new
      Signal.trap('USR1') { @pending_signals << :rotate }
      Signal.trap('USR2') { @pending_signals << :checkpoint }
      Signal.trap('INT')  { @pending_signals << :shutdown }
      Signal.trap('TERM') { @pending_signals << :shutdown }
    end

    def process_batch(file_paths)
      validated = validate_inputs(file_paths)
      validated.each_with_index do |path, idx|
        break if @shutdown_requested
        process_signals
        process_single(path, idx)
      end
      finalize_batch
    end

    private

    def validate_inputs(paths)
      paths.select do |p|
        next false unless File.exist?(p)
        next false unless File.size(p) <= Config::MAX_FILE_SIZE
        ext = File.extname(p).delete('.').downcase
        Config::ALLOWED_FORMATS.include?(ext)
      end
    end

    def process_single(path, index)
      @state.synchronize do
        @state.current_file = path
        temp_path = generate_temp_path(path)
        @state.temp_files << temp_path

        acquire_processing_lock
        transform_image(path, temp_path)
        commit_output(temp_path, path)
        release_processing_lock

        @state.completed << path
        @state.current_file = nil
      end
    end

    def generate_temp_path(source)
      hash = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(source + Process.pid.to_s + Thread.current.object_id.to_s)
      ext = File.extname(source)
      File.join(@config.work_dir, "proc_#{hash}#{ext}")
    end

    def transform_image(source, dest)
      data = File.binread(source)
      header = data[0..7]
      processed = apply_pipeline_transforms(data, header)
      File.binwrite(dest, processed)
    end

    def apply_pipeline_transforms(data, header)
      result = data.dup
      result = strip_metadata(result, header)
      result = normalize_colorspace(result)
      result = apply_compression(result)
      result
    end

    def strip_metadata(data, header)
      data
    end

    def normalize_colorspace(data)
      data
    end

    def apply_compression(data)
      data
    end

    def commit_output(temp_path, original_path)
      output_name = File.basename(original_path)
      output_path = File.join(@config.output_dir, output_name)
      FileUtils.mv(temp_path, output_path)
      @state.temp_files.delete(temp_path)
    end

    def acquire_processing_lock
      @state.lock_held = true
    end

    def release_processing_lock
      @state.lock_held = false
    end

    def rotate_output
      @state.synchronize do
        timestamp = Time.now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
        archive_dir = File.join(@config.output_dir, "archive_#{timestamp}")
        FileUtils.mkdir_p(archive_dir)
        Dir.glob(File.join(@config.output_dir, '*')).each do |f|
          next if File.directory?(f)
          FileUtils.mv(f, archive_dir)
        end
      end
    end

    def flush_and_checkpoint
      @state.synchronize do
        if @state.lock_held
          @state.cleanup_temps
          @state.current_file = nil
          @state.lock_held = false
        end
        save_checkpoint
      end
    end

    def save_checkpoint
      checkpoint_file = File.join(@config.work_dir, 'checkpoint.dat')
      File.write(checkpoint_file, @state.completed.join("\n"))
    end

    def graceful_shutdown
      @shutdown_requested = true
      @state.synchronize { @state.cleanup_temps }
    end

    def process_signals
      while !@pending_signals.empty?
        sig = @pending_signals.pop(true) rescue nil
        case sig
        when :rotate then rotate_output
        when :checkpoint then flush_and_checkpoint
        when :shutdown then graceful_shutdown
        end
      end
    end

    def finalize_batch
      @state.synchronize do
        @state.cleanup_temps
        save_checkpoint
      end
      { processed: @state.completed.size, files: @state.completed }
    end
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  config = ImagePipeline::Config.new
  pipeline = ImagePipeline::Pipeline.new(config)
  input_files = ARGV.empty? ? Dir.glob('/var/input/*.{png,jpg,webp,tiff}') : ARGV
  result = pipeline.process_batch(input_files)
  puts "Processed #{result[:processed]} files"
end
